items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: I played with Red Heart Mama, what's her name? Sophie Cousin. No. Yeah, I played two times with the same boss with her, but not with her. I played once at Rideswell.

ctx.x: And did Columbia issue those records? That's another question.

They didn't issue them till May, till the Liber Stable Blues became a national hit. It was all over the world, even down in Honolulu. And all the way the American forces went, they were carried overseas by the American troops, which we entertained over a million men. I had pastors to every fort and every hospital in New York. And we entertained the soldiers and sailors. I played on the bills with Caruso. I played on the bills with Jolson. I played on bills with Eddie Cantor. In fact, Eddie Cantor used to work…
